title: Misuse of market power: effects test (s 46)
summary: Section 46 of the Competition and Consumer Act was replaced to prohibit a firm with substantial market power from conduct with the purpose, effect or likely effect of substantially lessening competition.

instruments.title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Misuse of Market Power) Act 2017

commenced.what: Whole Act commenced with Schedule 1 of the Competition Policy Review Act

direction_rationale: An effects test makes exclusionary conduct by dominant firms easier to challenge, lowering strategic barriers for rivals.
comparison: none: national change (possible exposure-based designs across industries or firm sizes); concentrated vs unconcentrated industries
confounders: other Harper reforms commencing the same day
notes: Few cases litigated; expected effect via deterrence, hard to detect in aggregate data.
